tools.name: run_log_grep_scan
tools.description: Runs grep over a log file for a pattern and returns the matching lines along with counts. Executes the search as a subprocess on the server.

params.name: log_path
params.description: Path to the log file to scan

params.name: max_lines
params.description: Maximum number of matching lines to return

tools.code:
import subprocess
from pathlib import Path
from mcp.server.fastmcp import FastMCP

mcp = FastMCP("log-scan")
LOG_ROOT = Path("/var/log/app").resolve()


@mcp.tool()
def run_log_grep_scan(log_path: str, pattern: str, max_lines: int = 100) -> dict:
    result = {"log_path": log_path, "pattern": pattern, "matches": [], "total_matches": 0, "truncated": False, "error": None}
    target = Path(log_path).resolve()
    if LOG_ROOT not in target.parents or not target.is_file():
        result["error"] = "log file not found under log root"
        return result
    try:
        proc = subprocess.run(
            ["grep", "-n", "-E", "-e", pattern, str(target)],
            capture_output=True,
            text=True,
            timeout=30,
        )
    except subprocess.TimeoutExpired:
        result["error"] = "scan timed out"
        return result
    if proc.returncode == 2:
        result["error"] = proc.stderr.strip()
        return result
    lines = proc.stdout.splitlines()
    result["total_matches"] = len(lines)
    result["matches"] = lines[:max_lines]
    result["truncated"] = len(lines) > max_lines
    return result

tools.name: post_error_summary_to_slack
tools.description: Posts a summary of recent error counts from the application log database to a Slack channel through an incoming webhook.

params.name: channel
params.description: Slack channel name to post to

params.name: service
params.description: Service name whose errors are summarized

params.name: hours
params.description: How many past hours to include

tools.code:
import sqlite3
import requests

HOOK = "https://hooks.slack.com/services/T000/B000/XXXX"
DB = "logs.db"


def post_error_summary_to_slack(channel: str, service: str, hours: int) -> dict:
    q = "SELECT level, COUNT(*) FROM logs WHERE service = ? AND ts >= datetime('now', ?) AND level IN ('ERROR','CRITICAL') GROUP BY level"
    c = sqlite3.connect(DB)
    rows = c.execute(q, (service, f"-{int(hours)} hours")).fetchall()
    c.close()
    t = sum(n for _, n in rows)
    ls = [f"{lvl}: {n}" for lvl, n in rows]
    txt = f"*{service}* errors in last {hours}h: {t}\n" + "\n".join(ls)
    body = {"channel": channel, "text": txt}
    r = requests.post(HOOK, json=body, timeout=10)
    return {"status": r.status_code, "ok": r.ok, "total": t}

tools.name: trigger_log_rotation
